format: Moraff's Revenge statically recovered spell schema v1

notes: The executable asks for a level from 1 through 6, then one of the two spells in that level.
Several branches deliberately deduct their cost later than the common selection check; their exact no-cost and fall-through cases are recorded below.

preparation.name: FEATHER
quirks: If the result is below zero, it is clamped to zero, four spell points are deducted, and the spell returns normally.
If the result is zero or greater, execution falls through into ASCEND at 3819.
At dungeon level zero that fall-through reaches ASCEND's zero-level return without deducting spell points.

preparation.name: ASCEND
preparation.effect: print POOF; dungeon_level -= 1; enter town if the result is zero, otherwise initialize the dungeon view
preparation.failure: at dungeon level zero it returns without deducting spell points

preparation.name: CHANGE LEVEL
preparation.effect: delta = floor(RND * 10) - 5; if delta == 0 then delta = -1; dungeon_level = clamp(dungeon_level + delta, 0.5, 70)
preparation.quirk: clamping occurs after the executable's unchanged-level retry test, so an edge-level cast can consume points yet leave the level unchanged

preparation.name: MOCCIOLO
preparation.effect: roll = floor(RND * 6) + 1 and apply the selected outcome
outcomes: 1: add 1 to all six attributes and print WOW
2: set dungeon_level=0 and player_x=player_y=10, then enter town
3: set health_current=health_max and add 30 spell points
5: subtract 1 from all six attributes and print UH OH

6: subtract 2 from player_level, multiply experience by 0.25, then set health_max = max(1, health_max - floor(RND*10) - floor(RND*10) - 2*health_growth_factor + 2); health_current is later clamped to health_max

battle.name: GAS
battle.effect: if floor(RND*2)+1 != 1 and monster_level < 4, print the asleep message and deal floor(RND*5000)+1376 damage; otherwise NO EFFECT

battle.name: SPEED
battle.effect: agility += 11; marker = (movement_turn == 1 ? 16 : movement_turn) - 1; combat cleanup subtracts 11 when the marker is nonzero
battle.quirk: recasting adds another 11 but overwrites the same marker, while cleanup subtracts only 11 once

battle.name: STRENGTH
battle.effect: combat_attack_factor += 7; marker = (movement_turn == 1 ? 16 : movement_turn) - 1; combat cleanup subtracts 7 when the marker is nonzero
battle.quirk: recasting adds another 7 but overwrites the same marker, while cleanup subtracts only 7 once

battle.name: GO AWAY!
battle.effect: threshold = floor(RND*player_level*2)+5; if threshold > monster_level, set the suppress-kill-message flag and enter the normal experience/replacement/loot defeat pipeline; otherwise NO EFFECT
battle.quirk: successful GO AWAY! gives normal defeat rewards and loot but suppresses YOU KILLED IT!!

battle.name: RISE...
battle.effect: dungeon_level -= 1 and leave combat without removing the monster; enter town if the result is zero

battle.name: AUTO KILL
battle.effect: threshold = floor(RND*player_level*3)+5; enter the normal defeat flow if threshold > monster_level, otherwise NO EFFECT

battle.name: GOD?
battle.effect: roll = floor(RND*5)+1 and apply the selected outcome
outcomes: 2: deduct six spell points, set dungeon_level=0 and player_x=player_y=10, then enter town
3: deduct six spell points, set health_current=health_max, and return directly to combat input
5: deduct six spell points, subtract 1 from all six attributes, print UH OH, then fall through the ordinary non-damage completion path and deduct another six spell points (12 total)

steps: deduct the selected spell level from spell_points
enter monster defeat/loot if health is below one; otherwise continue with the monster turn
